name: p5_alzheimers_clinical
outcome_definition: Binary dementia status derived from Clinical Dementia Rating (CDR > 0) at the single cross-sectional visit. This is a same-visit association/screening-proxy label, not a longitudinal MCI-to-AD progression prediction as the spec's P5 task calls for — the OASIS-1 cross-sectional release only has one scan per subject, so no progression horizon can be defined from it alone. Research-only, per spec FR-033.
